name: create_product_system
title: Create a product system
description: Creates a new product system for the given process. The quantitative reference of the process becomes the reference flow of the product system, and the product inputs and waste outputs of the processes are linked automatically to providers in the database. The process must have a quantitative reference. Returns a reference to the new product system.

providerLinking.description: How default providers of the processes are considered in the linking (default: PREFER_DEFAULTS).

preferUnitProcesses.description: If true, unit processes are preferred over system processes when multiple providers exist (default: false).

cutoff.description: Optional cutoff value for the linking.
